purpose: Machine-readable negative cases that any evaluator of the TASK-0135 soak integration policy must reject. Each case names the policy rule that produces the rejection so coverage is checkable by script.

cases.scenario: A PASS artifact captured at source head 1111...aaaa is submitted as evidence for tip 2222...bbbb after the base advanced over native/networking.
cases.rationale: Greens are bound to an exact head and go stale on base advance over the soaked surface; reuse across heads is fabrication.

cases.scenario: The verdict bundle records os_name but omits os_version, cpu_architecture, and toolchain.
cases.rationale: All platform.evidence_required fields must be present or the verdict is invalid regardless of soak outcome.

cases.scenario: Every attempt in the session fails in phase server-start with binder error 'no free port in capsule 6680-6699'; no client upgrade was ever attempted; retries exhaust quarantine.limits.
cases.rationale: Persistent contention blocks the context with an environment question; it can never end in PASS for the software.

cases.scenario: A run configuration directs the listener to port 6500 instead of the lane capsule.
cases.rationale: Port 6500 is owner-reserved; touching it is a P0 protocol violation with immediate FAIL, halt, report, and no retry.

cases.scenario: The soak process exits with code 3 after the hard watchdog deadline, or a run exceeds its context wall-clock budget without completing all cycles plus burst.
cases.rationale: Timed-out or watchdog-aborted runs yield no green and no partial credit even if some cycles succeeded.

cases.scenario: The soak exits 1 with failures containing phase client-login on cycle 37 of a complete run; a second full run later exits 0 on the same head and is offered as the verdict.
cases.rationale: A deterministic failure fixes the verdict at FAIL for that head; no same-head retry may flip it to green.

cases.scenario: The build gate reports exit code 0 but no parseable lifecycle-soak JSON exists at the cited path (or the JSON lacks required fields such as passed, failures, burstPassed).
cases.rationale: Without a valid artifact the run is FAIL; stdout-derived numbers are inadmissible as evidence.

cases.scenario: Attempt 1 failed with MISSING_ARTIFACT; attempt 2 passed. The verdict cites only attempt 2's artifact and omits attempt 1 from the session record.
cases.rationale: Hiding a failed or missing run behind a passing retry invalidates the entire verdict session.
